lines.text: Many learners say: She is more tall than me.
Better: She is taller than me.
The first! My brother is taller than me.

data.wrong: She is more tall than me.

options: My brother is taller than me.
My brother is more tall than me.

native.tip: Com palavras curtas como “tall”, acrescente “-er”: “taller”, sem “more”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “She is more tall than me.” O certo é “She is taller than me.” Em português dizemos “mais alta”, mas em inglês palavras curtas pedem “-er”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “My brother is taller than me.” Agora diga em voz alta uma frase sua com esse ponto e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: With short words like “tall”, add “-er”: “taller”, without “more”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “She is more tall than me.” The right way is “She is taller than me.” In Portuguese we say “mais alta”, but short English words take “-er”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
